allow: Driving the person's disposable UTM VMs through their VM tool (/Users/user/Code/vm/vm prepare, start, stop, exec, ssh, ssh-config, reset, status), and copying files into or out of those VMs with scp/rsync/ssh, is explicitly allowed: the person gave agents full use of these VMs, including breaking and resetting them.

hooks.command: jq -c '.tool_input as $input | (.cwd // "") as $cwd | "^[ \t]*git[ \t]+-C[ \t]+(?<path>[^[:space:]]+)" as $pattern | (try ($input.command | capture($pattern)) catch {}) | select((.path // "") as $path | $path == "." or $path == "./" or ($path | rtrimstr("/")) == ($cwd | rtrimstr("/"))) | {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",updatedInput:($input | .command |= sub($pattern; "git"))}}'
